memoryRule: a near crossing only arms; a distant gate replies by changing source, target, relay, and one shared even-odd contour
interactionRule: pointerdown arms the nearest cavity and pointerup at a distant cavity commits; same-gate return refuses; Enter twice shares the path; Delete lifts latest; Escape or R releases

temporalRupture: departure, fused-seam, and inherited body memory -> bounded topological replies that alter one body and can be lifted exactly
mediumRupture: same inline SVG medium, but the work is now a single even-odd filled contour rather than a population of objects
promotion: candidate / held pending local and production browser matrices, independent caption-free perceptual review, and provider revision linkage
